[EXPERIMENTAL] Get the details of a policy exception

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Get the details of a policy exception.

Shows a policy exception, including what it exempts as a Policy Pack exceptions
configuration entry.

Default output is a human-readable summary; pass --output=json for the
full response as JSON.

```
pulumi policy exception get <exception-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  pulumi policy exception get EXC-12
  pulumi policy exception get EXC-12 --output json
```

## Options

```
  -h, --help            help for get
      --org string      The organization that owns the exception
      --output string   Output format. Supported values are: default and json (default "default")
```
